identification: Mixed accumulation of about 40 badges and pins: Scottish-style SAC cap badge, Rising Sun type badges, MCC 1965-66 member badge no. 6686, LGH Miseris Succurrere disc, Magpies football badge, 1938 Australian YMCA Tournament Sydney pin (Mrs Ross Jones), CPA platinum pin in box, Red Cross badges, cloth insignia and rank stripes. Worn, mostly common types.
